package.name: tm12_bottle_sorting
package.description: Sorts returned glass bottles into crates by brand using an Omron TM12 cobot and two Intel RealSense depth cameras. Built for 41069 Robotics Studio 2 at UTS. Bottles are located with a Hough circle transform, classified with YOLOv5, and placed by brand; a MediaPipe safety node halts the arm while a person is in the workspace.
